messages.subject: CFA can be found
parts:
Dear all

I can't use the cfa fuction, R can't find the cfa fuction. 

> fit_model1<-cfa(model1, data=SCQ, estimator="MLM")
Error in cfa(model1, data = SCQ, estimator = "MLM") : 
  no se pudo encontrar la función "cfa"

Then I checked lavaan in my library, and I got this error: 

> library(lavaan)
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘lavaan’ in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]):
 there is no package called ‘mnormt’
Además: Warning message:
package ‘lavaan’ was built under R version 3.6.3 

Any help?

Many thanks in advance!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: CFA can be found
parts: > package ‘lavaan’ was built under R version 3.6.3

This is the problem. You need to upgrade to R 4.0.2 (the current
version). The reason is that the mnormt packages was recently updated,
and now requires R > 4.0.0.

lavaan currently depends on mnormt, although I plan to drop this
dependency in an next update (exactly for this reason).

Yves.
